14.title: Percentage coupons (closes #12)
14.body:
Adds percentage coupons with a cap and an expiry date, and a preview endpoint so the cart can show the total before applying a code. SPRING20 is in COUPONS.

Closes #12

12.title: Percentage coupons
12.author: shop-lead
12.body:
We want percentage coupons for the spring campaign: SPRING20 takes 20% off, capped at 30.00, until the end of April 2027.

## Acceptance criteria

1. A percentage coupon takes `percent`% off the order subtotal, rounded down to the cent.
2. The discount never exceeds the coupon's `max_off_cents`.
3. A coupon with `expires_on` is rejected with `CouponExpired` once `expires_on` has passed. It still works on the `expires_on` day itself.
4. The same coupon can't be applied twice to one order: raise `CouponAlreadyApplied`.

comments.body: Confirmed with marketing: the cap is per order, not per item.
